title: Creamy Broccoli Soup
subtitle: with carrot and melted gouda
description: A thick, creamy broccoli and carrot soup thickened with a flour roux, enriched with cream and finished with melted gouda.

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pot and add the chopped onion. Fry only until translucent, then add the crushed garlic.
Stir briefly, lower the heat and add the flour. Stir continuously with a wooden spoon until the flour turns golden.
Turn the heat up and add the broccoli florets and finely grated carrots. Stir and add the hot stock.
Add the paprika (add the salt and pepper only at the end, once the soup and cheese have seasoned it naturally).

Bring the soup to the boil, lower the heat and cook uncovered for 50 minutes, until the liquid reduces and the soup loses about a quarter of its volume. Stir occasionally with a wooden spoon, scraping the bottom and sides of the pot so the flour does not stick.
Add the cream and bring back to the boil.
Lower the heat and cook for about 15 minutes uncovered, until thickened.
Add the grated gouda and keep cooking until it melts completely into the soup.
Taste and add salt and pepper as needed.
